about_the_game:
Odd Jobs

A physics-powered, four-player co-op simulation set in a vibrant Australian carpark. Teammates race to complete a rotating roster of odd jobs. Collect stray trolleys, unload delivery trucks, blast grime with a high-pressure water truck, or deliver groceries directly to customers’ boot. Aim for the fastest time, least damage, and highest payouts.

On The Lot

In Odd Jobs on the Lot, you and your friends take on the most overlooked but essential tasks of the car park—return runaway trolleys, clean up rubbish, wash cars, deliver parcels, and load groceries straight into customers’ boots. Sounds simple? Think again. With chaotic physics, time pressure, and unexpected obstacles (like mischievous shoppers and rogue traffic cones), these odd jobs turn into hilarious challenges.

Features

  • 15+ increasingly wacky levels of car park mayhem

  • A whole cast of Australian and international animals in customisable outfits

  • Return trolleys, clean messes, wash dirty cars, and perform “direct to boot” deliveries

  • Hop into drivable vehicles to help (or hinder) your progress

  • Take on parcel delivery missions and time-sensitive jobs

  • Solo mode for the lone worker… or 2–4 player co-op for maximum chaos

  • Co-op tasks that require real coordination—split up or team up to finish jobs efficiently

  • Master each level to climb the job performance board!

  • Originally scored soundtrack featuring jazz, rock, and beats by award-winning Epoch Music composers—bringing energy and style to every shift!

Whether you’re playing alone or laughing with friends, Odd Jobs on the Lot turns everyday errands into a slapstick adventure of teamwork, timing, and trolley wrangling.
